I saved Tobias's standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team for the Tamarack rollout (Thursdays at 9:30 from now on) as a new memory and added it to the memory index. The memory notes that it came from Tobias's direct message, so it should only be used with Tobias and not mentioned in channels or to other members.

There was already a memory about Pree's Marrow Fieldworks call for the Thistle rollout. I kept them as separate entries and noted the difference so the two calls don't get mixed up.

I replied to Tobias in the DM to confirm. As asked, I didn't change anything on the calendar.
